continuing_physical_or_resource_constrai: Galoc existing-well work-program deliverability, decline and cessation

annual_capability.interpretation: Semirara legal/design mine envelope; the 2025 ECC amendment establishes 20 Mt/y only through 2027, so the prior 16 Mt/y envelope resumes afterward.

coal.opening_reserve_calculation: DOE mineable reserve at 2023-12-31 (362.067415 Mt) plus national 2020-2023 depletion (12.951 + 14.048 + 14.457 + 14.800 Mt).
coal.extraction_cost_calculation: PHP 22.048 billion coal cash cost / 15.4 Mt shipments / 57.5051 PHP per USD / 22.1 GJ per tonne; inherited temporal shape retained around the anchor.

annual_deliverability.2020-2025_method: Backcast the operator's 2026 three-cargo work-program envelope at the stated 10% annual field decline.
annual_deliverability.2027_method: Prorate 360,000 bbl over 76 days through planned 17 March cessation.

oil.extraction_cost_calculation: Approved 2026 firm budget of USD 20.04 million / 360,000 bbl / 6.119 GJ per barrel; inherited temporal shape retained around the anchor.

trade_representation.method: Domestic extraction produces source-tagged coal/oil. A unit bridge can feed the existing domestic raw-fuel pool, or an optional consume-only export technology can receive export revenue. Imports continue to feed only the existing domestic pool and cannot reach either export sink.
trade_representation.export_activity_constraints: None beyond gross domestic extraction deliverability and reserve constraints.
trade_representation.post_2027_price_assumption: The 2027 World Bank forecast is held constant because no cited longer-horizon series was introduced; this is disclosed rather than treated as observed activity.
